generation: Original seeded Python physical-inspired, granular, modal, filtered-noise and formant synthesis; no recordings, extracted samples, cloned voices, words or speech API.
generation_or_recording_prompt: Produce original audio for Dave's & Enemies, a smooth cartoon desert action adventure. Asset snd_sword_hit: Successful damage from Dave's sword. Create a readable cartoon sword impact: crisp dry metal tick, short woody body thump and a tight gritty edge. No wet gore, long ring, whoosh or vocal. It must read in 50 ms and remain pleasant under repetition. Deliver 3 separate distinct takes, each 0.22 seconds long including decay. Keep variants matched in perceived loudness and function; vary performance and texture rather than large pitch changes. This is a single event, not a loop; do not add a second event or a montage. No intelligible words, dialogue sentences, music, background ambience or unrelated actions. Use original recordings or synthesis; do not sample reference games, copy recognizable character voices, or imitate a named performer. Export WAV, signed PCM 16-bit, 44.1 kHz, mono, peak no higher than -1 dBFS. Judge short sounds by peak and perceived loudness; do not force an integrated LUFS target. No leading dead air; preserve designed decay and 2-5 ms click-free edge envelopes.
